analysis_policy: No plots, PDE/model outcomes, timings, parameter tuning, new inference or independent-site claim; acquisition only. Any later physics must have its own frozen protocol.
crop_center_rule: start_axis=floor(fraction*(axis_length-1)-(window_length-1)/2); zero-based half-open windows; record actual pixel midpoint

documentation.terms: Accept original disclaimer; acknowledge BP and Frederic Billette; cite Billette and Brandsberg-Dahl2005; retain all original documentation/notices on redistribution; document modifications.

layout.format1: IBM32 decoded using sign * fraction24 / 2**24 * 16**(exponent7-64), represented as float32 after finite-positive check
layout.gzip_policy: one gzip member only, CRC32 and ISIZE checked by zlib and matched to complete streamed bytes; reject truncation, trailing members/bytes and unexpected layout
layout.trace_order: file trace index is increasing x; trace sample index is increasing z; no reordering from header coordinates
layout.value_validation: every decoded velocity must be finite and strictly positive; no clipping, interpolation, rescaling or value-driven choice

outputs.header_encoding: text/binary exact base64; all trace headers concatenated then zlib+base64 with decoded-bytecount and SHA256
outputs.metadata: protocol+source snapshots, full original PDF, README_Modification, source/input/output SHA256, full lossless raw headers and layout, gzip CRC32/ISIZE and all parent coordinates
outputs.velocity_outputs: three raw NPY crops and three stride NPY crops only; combined array data663552bytes

role: prospective named external synthetic-ancestor stress acquisition; no model selection or outcome evaluation

source.http_policy: HTTP200, exact Content-Length and ETag, identity transfer, no redirected URL, bounded body; no archive written to disk

transforms.isotropic: raw[::2,::1], yielding96x192 at12.5mx12.5m; no interpolation or clipping
transforms.raw: retain all original decoded samples in each fixed192x192 window as C-order little-endian float32
